_doc: The fleet data manifest served by Cloud Store (tiers 3-4: app defaults and reference data). Read at runtime by the providers' sync from raw.githubusercontent.com (ETag); never baked into an APK. shared.<dataset>: who may read it (consumers: package names or "*"), its tier, and the repo path it is pulled from (source, default data/fleet/<dataset>.json). apps.<package>: the datasets served at app/<package>/<dataset> (file data/fleet/app/<package>/<dataset>.json), readable by that package alone. Tiers 1-2 (personal, fleet/infra) are NEVER listed here: Cloud Account serves them from the private route. Checked by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-runtime-data-guard.py.
